2163:     def _copy_draft_token_ids_to_cpu(
2164:         self, scheduler_output: "SchedulerOutput", zeros_only: bool = False
2165:     ) -> None:
2166:         # Record the width of the drafts just produced so the next step unpacks
2167:         # the previous-step draft tensor with the right stride. Under dynamic SD
2168:         # this width can change step to step (mirrors vLLM's GPUModelRunner
2169:         # ``prev_num_spec_tokens`` bookkeeping). Kept before the early returns so
2170:         # it is updated even when the CPU copy itself is skipped.
2171:         if isinstance(self._draft_token_ids, torch.Tensor):
2172:             self.prev_num_spec_tokens = self._draft_token_ids.shape[1]
2173:         if not self.num_spec_tokens:
2174:             return
2175:         if self.use_async_scheduling and not (
2176:             scheduler_output.has_structured_output_requests
2177:             or self.input_batch.sampling_metadata.output_token_ids
2178:             or get_pp_group().world_size > 1
2179:         ):
2180:             return
2181:         self._draft_token_req_ids = self.input_batch.req_ids.copy()
2182: 
2183:         draft_token_ids = self._draft_token_ids
2184:         if not isinstance(draft_token_ids, torch.Tensor):
2185:             return
2186:         assert self.draft_token_ids_event is not None
2187:         assert self.draft_token_ids_copy_stream is not None
2188:         assert self.draft_token_ids_cpu is not None
2189:         default_stream = torch.npu.current_stream()
2190:         num_reqs = draft_token_ids.shape[0]
2191:         # Slice the pre-allocated CPU buffer (sized for the configured maximum
2192:         # K) to the *actual* draft width. Under dynamic SD the produced width
2193:         # can be < max, so an unsliced copy would shape-mismatch.
2194:         num_spec_tokens = draft_token_ids.shape[1]
2195:         with torch.npu.stream(self.draft_token_ids_copy_stream):
2196:             if not zeros_only:
2197:                 self.draft_token_ids_copy_stream.wait_stream(default_stream)
2198:                 self.draft_token_ids_cpu[:num_reqs, :num_spec_tokens].copy_(
2199:                     draft_token_ids, non_blocking=True
2200:                 )
2201:             else:
2202:                 self.draft_token_ids_cpu[:num_reqs, :num_spec_tokens] = 0
2203:             self.draft_token_ids_event.record()
